project.title: PCJ-S Pre-Cut Jig
project.sub: Manual pre-cut jig for Nudura straight forms

renders.title: Whole jig
renders.desc: Bench, side and end bars, V guides (blue), A guide (orange), G guide parked (green), saw on V1.

renders.title: Whole jig, rear
renders.desc: Far side: pushers, latch posts, outrigger H-frames.

renders.title: Drop-on saw shoe
renders.desc: Twin sprung latch jaws (yellow) with click-open detents and trip pins: the saw goes on straight down.

renders.title: V guide square head
renders.desc: Guide screwed and dowelled to the head; cams outboard; lens cursor in the fence.

renders.title: Far-side pusher
renders.desc: Push toggle clamp on a frame-mounted body; guided carrier; acetal pad Z 445-715 for every series.

renders.title: End gate
renders.desc: Folds out and down onto rubber buffers; light spring stop strips; norelem latches.

renders.title: Side-bar bracket
renders.desc: Jacking screws with lock nuts, clamp bolts with heavy washers, T-bolts into the profile.

renders.title: End bar and G park ledge
renders.desc: End-bar bracket on the portal beam; 45x45 park ledge on cast brackets.

renders.title: X datum and Y fence
renders.desc: Hardened datum bars, shimmed datum plate, EPS run-off block on its shelf.

renders.title: A guide rack
renders.desc: Left (datum) end, clear of the loading path: the A guide lifts off onto these arms.

docs.title: Review triage R1
docs.sub: About 80 reviewer findings and their dispositions

docs.title: Fastener schedule
docs.sub: Generated from the model: designation, role, qty, torque, install notes; purchase totals; bought-out hardware
